name: Feature request
about: Propose a verifiable improvement for a maintained project
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ""

---

## Problem and users

Describe what is missing and who needs it.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the desired behavior. Do not assume a particular implementation.

## Acceptance and evidence

Explain exactly how the change can be tested and accepted.

## Compatibility, security and risks

Include important dependencies, privacy boundaries and rollback considerations.

> Check whether the target is a maintained organization project or a fork whose upstream accepts issues. Never include private data.
